incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired · service=embed-queue · severity=critical · incident=PD-98721 · link=https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-98721
Maria Chen: ack — I'm on it, grabbing initial logs and impact. pinging @Jake if we need routing help.
pagerbot: Auto-ack recorded (Maria Chen). Escalation timer: 10m.
Maria Chen: quick context: sudden spike in queue depth -> backend 502/504 from embedder. Started ~15:12 UTC, error rate 18% for last 5m. customer-facing errors reported.
Leo Kim: seeing the same in eu-west metrics, requests piling on embedder-primary. Logs show `kvcache miss flood` + 503s.
Ronald SRE: possible KVCACHE eviction storm. Can we toggle prefix caching or fall back to cached model variant?
Maria Chen: good call. I'm going to scale embedder pool and enable fallback routing. Running command: 
```
rbctl scale --pool embedder-eu --replicas 6
rbctl config set embedder-eu fallback_variant=embedder-v2-small
```
Jake Patel: I'm taking ownership of mitigation (on call). Will coordinate traffic reroute to fallback variant and monitor customer impact.
Maria Chen: handing off to Jake — I'll stay on monitoring. Customers flagged: 12 (high priority: acme.co, finlytics, chatly). Routing dashboard: https://console.redwood-inference/internal/routing/PD-98721
Jake Patel: starting progressive reroute: `rdeployer route set --service embedder --target fallback-v2 --percent 40` -> monitoring errors.
pagerbot: Note: PagerDuty escalation will notify on-call SRE if incident not resolved within 10m.
Jake Patel: update 2m: reroute at 40% -> error rate dropped to 9%, latency improved. Increasing to 70% now.
Leo Kim: EU error rate trending down. KVCACHE eviction events still visible but less severe.
Maria Chen: posting a quick customer-impact note to CS: "We’re actively mitigating embedder errors; partial reroute reduces failures; CS will notify impacted accounts."
Jake Patel: reroute at 70% complete. Observed steady reduction, customer errors down ~75% over baseline. Continuing until stable, then full cutover.
Ronald SRE: creating a temporary guardrail: disable aggressive cache evictions and restart embedder workers one-by-one to avoid thrashing.
Maria Chen: noted — adding to runbook and will capture commands used in postmortem.
Jake Patel: marking incident ownership (Jake Patel) in PD. I'll update every 10m or on significant change. ETA to stable ~10m.
pagerbot: PD note recorded: owner=Jake Patel.
incidentbot: bridge created for PD-98721: https://meet.redwood/bridge/PD-98721 (auto-closed after incident resolved).
Maria Chen: thanks — I’ll follow up with metrics and logs for RCA.
Jake Patel: current status: mitigation in progress, traffic routed to fallback, customer impact reduced. If things hold, will start recovery steps and then a controlled rollback to primary with throttled ramp.
Leo Kim: ping if you want me to stay on bridge.
Ronald SRE: heading offline but reachable by pager if anything spikes.
Maria Chen: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. I'll open an RCA ticket and link it to PD-98721.
Jake Patel: will post final resolution and blameless RCA links once confirmed stable.
Maria Chen: closing loop for now — adding note to incident timeline.
